Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on a search snippet indicating Buck-Tick was “formed in Tokyo” and surfaced “Origin: Tokyo, Japan” without verifying by opening authoritative sources. Canonical references (e.g., Wikipedia’s infobox and multiple biographies) list Buck-Tick’s origin as Fujioka, Gunma, Japan. This premature acceptance of an unverified snippet led the Planner to conclude “Tokyo, Japan,” propagating the incorrect detail into the final answer.
